edges.reason: Owner state variable is assigned directly from msg.sender in the constructor and gates every privileged function.
changeTxnTax reverts unless msg.sender equals owner.
mint only executes when msg.sender is the owner and canMintBurn is true.
burn only executes when msg.sender is the owner and canMintBurn is true.
changeHoldingTax reverts unless msg.sender is the owner.
changeHoldingTaxInterval reverts unless msg.sender is the owner.
addAddressManual requires msg.sender to be owner while the token is private.
removeAddressManual requires msg.sender to be owner while the token is private.
transfer debits and credits balances keyed by the caller address.
Transaction tax is collected out of the caller transfer and forwarded to owner.
chargeHoldingTax depends on block timestamp through now and lastHoldingTax; miners can influence timing.
lastHoldingTax is overwritten with now, making tax settlement timestamp dependent.
Elapsed tax time is derived from now minus lastHoldingTax.
Constructor normalises lastHoldingTax by repeatedly reading now inside while loops.
transfer performs unchecked unsigned subtraction on the sender balance.
transfer performs unchecked unsigned addition on the recipient balance.
mint performs unchecked unsigned addition on the minter balance.
mint performs unchecked unsigned addition on totalSupply.
burn performs unchecked unsigned subtraction on the owner balance.
burn performs unchecked unsigned subtraction on totalSupply.
Holding tax deduction loops over holders applying unchecked subtraction.
Holding tax credit loops over holders applying unchecked addition to the owner balance.
Constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender without an overflow guard.
owner.send is executed before balances are updated in transfer, allowing a reentrant call back into transfer.
_value drives the sender balance debit.
_to is the key credited in the recipient balance mapping.
_value is added to the recipient balance.
Mint amount flows into the minter balance update.
Burn amount flows into the owner balance update.
Constructor supply argument is written to the caller balance.

transfer calls chargeHoldingTax before performing the value transfer.
transfer registers the recipient through addAddress.
Constructor registers the owner through addAddress.
The stored transaction tax is the amount sent to the owner inside transfer.
Crowdsale owner is assigned from msg.sender and gates endPresale, withdraw and updatePresaleNumbers.
endPresale is callable only by the owner.
withdraw is callable only by the owner.
updatePresaleNumbers is callable only by the owner.
Fallback uses the caller address as buyer for balances and refunds.
Leftover ether is refunded to the caller address.
Purchased tokens are credited to the caller balance.
endPresale decision depends on block timestamp versus the last sale date.
Fallback rejects purchases outside the timestamp window bounded by dates.
Bonus percent is selected by comparing block timestamp against stage dates.
Fallback decrements the remaining supply with unchecked arithmetic.
Fallback credits buyer tokens with unchecked addition.
Fallback subtracts twice the previous sale delta from the remaining supply without checks.
Manual synchronisation subtracts twice the delta without checks.
Token amount is computed with several unchecked multiplications and divisions.
msg.value is scaled by 100 with unchecked multiplication.
finish sends the full balance to finalAddress, allowing reentry into the sale termination flow.
withdraw performs an external send to finalAddress, exposing the withdrawal flow to reentrant calls.
Refund send to msg.sender at the end of the fallback lets the caller reenter the buy function.

Stage timestamps are compared with block timestamp to validate the sale window.
Stage percent table populates the bonus percent applied to the purchase.
Scaled msg.value is divided by the token price to derive the token amount.
pricePerToken is the denominator used when computing tokensToGive.
Remaining supply is decremented by the amount given to the buyer.
Remaining supply is reduced by the previous sale delta in the fallback path.
Buyer balance mapping is credited with the purchased tokens.
Cached previous sale counter is used to compute the delta in the fallback.
Snapshot of the sold counter feeds the delta used in the update function.
